blockerCatalog.label: PO not acknowledged
blockerCatalog.description: GVI Buy will not let you Create Invoice until the PO is acknowledged. Status PO Sent 3PS means this is still open.

blockerCatalog.label: Portal e-invoice not created
blockerCatalog.description: The Fieldwork invoice exists; the GVI Buy invoice does not. Payment will not start until the portal invoice is created and submitted.

blockerCatalog.label: Fieldwork PDF not attached
blockerCatalog.description: Create the portal invoice, then attach the Fieldwork PDF. Missing attachment is a common reject / stall.

blockerCatalog.label: PDF may include balance-forward
blockerCatalog.description: Fieldwork sometimes prints prior balances on the PDF. Agencies bounce those. Export or edit so only this job’s dollars appear.

blockerCatalog.label: Agency receipt not complete
blockerCatalog.description: Portal invoice is in. The agency still has to receive against the PO before approval and payment.

blockerCatalog.label: W-9 not confirmed at this agency
blockerCatalog.description: If the vendor file is missing a W-9, the check will not print even after approval.

blockerCatalog.label: SAM inactive
blockerCatalog.description: Federal / GVI pay files often require an active SAM record. Current reprint expires 11 Aug 2027 — keep it active.

blockerCatalog.label: Wrong or missing PO# on invoice face
blockerCatalog.description: The number on the Fieldwork PDF must match the GVI Buy PO being billed, including the :line suffix.

blockerCatalog.label: Amount short of PO
blockerCatalog.description: You may bill what Fieldwork supports. Do not inflate to the PO. Record the shortfall and find the missing tickets or leave them off.

blockerCatalog.label: PO amount vs invoiced amount mismatch
blockerCatalog.description: Invoice is smaller than the PO, or the PO total is unknown. Bill only documented Fieldwork dollars.

blockerCatalog.label: HOLD — PO dollars unreconciled
blockerCatalog.description: Email amount and portal amount disagree, or work is not finished. Do not invoice.

blockerCatalog.label: Verify not unpaid before chasing
blockerCatalog.description: Portal says Complete Receipt or Closed. That is not proof a check cleared. Check Fieldwork and the bank first.

blockerCatalog.label: Do not re-create portal invoice
blockerCatalog.description: An e-invoice already exists (Remaining to Invoice $0). Duplicating it will stall payment.
